subject: System Design
title: CQRS: Separate Reads from Writes
description: A quick win: understand CQRS: Separate Reads from Writes.

hook.text: What if you used one database model for writing data and a completely different one for reading it?

buildup.text: CQRS — Command Query Responsibility Segregation — splits the write model from the read model.

discovery.text: Writes go to a normalized, transactional store. Reads come from a denormalized, query-optimized view.

twist.text: The two models must stay in sync, usually through events. Eventual consistency is inherent.

climax.text: CQRS is powerful for systems with very different read and write patterns, but overkill for simple apps.
